newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Persson says Sweden in no hurry to join ERM - paper. [CORRECTED 13:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Persson says Sweden in no hurry to join ERM - paper. [CORRECTED 13:00 GMT]

text.p: Sweden is in no hurry to emulate Finland's weekend move and join the European Union's exchange rate mechanism, Prime Minister Goran Persson said in comments published on Tuesday (corrects from Wednesday).

In an interview with the London-based Financial Times, Persson said it would still be possible to join European economic and monetary union from its planned start on January 1, 1999, but that a decision about ERM would not be announced soon.
"We have such a strong position today that we don't need to bother about what others do," Persson told the newspaper.
"All the basic facts are in favour of Sweden, so we can wait. There (will be) no decisions about a Swedish ERM connection in the near future; no decision at all."
